name: Shirogane
source:
A loyal retainer of Fujiwara no Yasuhira, one of the heir of Oshu Fujiwara family.
A refined youth whose temperment is quite reserved.
He's on the side of the Priestess.
and rather resembles the Taira general, Taira no Tomomori.

[Spoiler] He is amnesiac and his real name is Taira no Shigehira, one of Heike's general and also the younger brother of Tomomori[/Spoiler]
